mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_DETAIL JOIN MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE ROLE_CODE = 'STUDENT'

SELECT SM.USER_NAME AS studentName , SM.PHONE AS phone , CM.USER_NAME AS counselorName , S.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , S.STUDENT_STATUS AS status , S.STUDENT_NO AS studentNo FROM STUDENT_DETAIL S JOIN MEMBER SM ON (SM.USER_NO = S.USER_NO) JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE C ON(S.COUNSELOR_NO = C.COUNSEL_NO) JOIN MEMBER CM ON (CM.USER_NO = C.USER_NO) WHERE SM.ROLE_CODE = 'STUDENT' ORDER BY STUDENT_NO DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM STUDENT_DETAIL JOIN MEMBER USING(USER_NO) WHERE (USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR PHONE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') AND ROLE_CODE = 'STUDENT'
AND STUDENT_STATUS = 'ATTENDING'
AND STUDENT_STATUS = 'ABSENT'

SELECT SM.USER_NAME AS studentName , SM.PHONE AS phone , CM.USER_NAME AS counselorName , S.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , S.STUDENT_STATUS AS status , S.STUDENT_NO AS studentNo FROM STUDENT_DETAIL S JOIN MEMBER SM ON (SM.USER_NO = S.USER_NO) JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE C ON(S.COUNSELOR_NO = C.COUNSEL_NO) JOIN MEMBER CM ON (CM.USER_NO = C.USER_NO) WHERE (SM.USER_NAME LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR SM.PHONE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%') AND SM.ROLE_CODE = 'STUDENT'
AND STUDENT_STATUS = 'ATTENDING'
AND STUDENT_STATUS = 'ABSENT'
ORDER BY STUDENT_NO DESC

SELECT S.STUDENT_NO AS studentNo , SM.USER_NO AS userNo , SM.USER_NAME AS studentName , SM.PHONE AS phone , SM.EMAIL AS email , SM.CREATED_AT AS createdAt , CLASS_NAME AS className , CM.USER_NAME AS counselorName , S.STUDENT_STATUS AS status , S.UPDATED_AT AS updatedAt FROM STUDENT_DETAIL S JOIN MEMBER SM ON (S.USER_NO = SM.USER_NO) JOIN CLASS CL ON (SM.CLASS_NO = CL.CLASS_NO) JOIN COUNSELOR_PROFILE C ON(S.COUNSELOR_NO = C.COUNSEL_NO) JOIN MEMBER CM ON (CM.USER_NO = C.USER_NO) WHERE S.STUDENT_NO = #{studentNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_MEMO(MEMO_NO , USER_NO , USER_MEMO) VALUES(SEQ_MEMO_NO.NEXTVAL , #{userNo} , #{userMemo})
mapper.select: SELECT USER_MEMO AS userMemo , MEMO_NO AS memoNo FROM MEMBER_MEMO WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
